problemCases.expectation: The public dispatch entry omits the executor surface.
`nextRetryDelay` tests `retryAfter` by truthiness, so a server-provided `retryAfter` of 0 falls back to the computed backoff instead of a 0 ms delay.
`executeAuthorizedPlan` awaits dispatch as an argument of `unlessForbidden`, so dispatch runs before the authorization result is applied.

`stopsForDriver` compares each stop's own `driver`, so a stop with a `reassignment` is returned for its original driver and not for the driver of its `reassignment`, which rule 30 makes its assigned driver.
`chooseDeparture` moves a blackout departure to the blackout end hour without refusing it when that hour is outside the departure window.
No available contract establishes when `store.write` invokes `onCommit`, so it cannot be established that `plan.created` is emitted only after storage succeeds.
`hasDuplicateRouteKeys` concatenates the depot ID and normalized route key without a separator, so different route identities can produce the same key.
`parseRetryCount` converts text with `Number`, so text that is not base-10 digits, such as `'0x2'`, `'2e0'`, `' 2'` or `''`, is accepted as a retry count.
`pendingStops` drops only stops whose `state` is `delivered`, so a stop whose `state` is `handedOver`, which rule 31 makes a delivered stop, is still returned.

`orderedDestinationGroups` passes the `Map` returned by `groupByDestination` to `orderManifestGroups`, whose comparator reads a `destination` field that the `[key, group]` entries lack, so the groups keep insertion order instead of ascending lexical order.

The geocoder contract defines `geocoder.lookup` only for known addresses, so it cannot be established whether an unknown address resolves to `undefined` (left out), resolves to another value (kept) or rejects (the whole call rejects).
`withinVehicleCapacity` converts the limit to grams and requires the clamped remainder to be above zero, so a total equal to the limit (remainder 0) is rejected.
`canPlanRoute` checks `routes:admin` in the actor's own scopes instead of its held scopes, so an admin scope held through an active claim does not meet the ownership requirement.
`effectiveScopes` drops only the actor's own scopes when it is suspended and still adds active-claim scopes, so a suspended actor with an active `routes:plan` claim can plan.
`handleAnnouncementFailure` removes the copy returned by `store.get`, and `store.remove` removes only the exact stored object, so the stored manifest is not removed.
`stripCredentials` recurses only into values whose constructor is `Object`, so credentials inside arrays below `auth` are kept.
`buildManifest` copies each record shallowly and `labelDriver` assigns the label onto the supplied driver object, so supplied records are mutated.
`publishManifest` maps entries through an async callback, and every resulting promise is truthy, so a manifest with invalid entries is stored.
`asPublicationError` marks a failure transient when it has a finite `retryAfter` even if it is marked `transient: false`, so `publishWithRetry` retries a failure rule 27 makes non-transient.
`coalesceAcrossGroups` records raw package IDs but filters normalized IDs, so a duplicate that differs only in surrounding whitespace survives in a later group.

problemCases.expectation: Route duration adds the raw `serviceMinutes`, so every stop misses the 5 minutes of parking that rule 32 includes in its service time.
Manifest-event redaction leaves arrays unvisited, so a credential in an object inside an array of the authentication data is not removed.
The announcement failure branch passes the new copy from `store.get` to `store.remove`, which removes nothing for any object other than the stored one.
Package coalescing compares normalized IDs against raw IDs seen in earlier groups, so whitespace variants of one ID are kept across groups.
After `renameTemporary` rejects, the temporary bytes are locked, so the `discardTemporary` call in `writePlanAtomically` only closes the write and keeps them; `removeTemporary` is never called.
`canAssignAllPackages` delegates to `withinVehicleCapacity`, whose remaining-capacity test is false at zero remainder, so a total equal to the limit is rejected.
The public entry does not export `executor.mjs`.

Plan serialization sorts only the top-level keys (`withSortedKeys` proxies only the plan object), so nested objects keep their insertion order and plans that differ only in nested field order hash to different values.
Urgent-stop partitioning tests the raw `priority` for the remaining partition, so a text priority such as `'7'` (priority 5 under rule 15) is placed in no partition.
`nextDispatchTime` checks the blackout with the host-local hour instead of the UTC hour, so on a non-UTC host a time inside the blackout is not moved.
Plan-created telemetry depends on when the store invokes `onCommit`, which no available contract defines.
The stop comparator coerces a text `sequence` such as `'2'` to a number, so a stop without a finite numeric sequence does not follow the equal-priority stops that have one.
`authorizeRouteBatch` accepts the batch when `findIndex` returns 0, so a batch whose first route fails depot ownership is authorized.
The weighing contract does not state the unit of the weight that `scale.read` resolves to, so it cannot be established that weighed package weights are in grams.
Arguments are evaluated before `unlessForbidden` runs, so authorized execution invokes dispatch before it can reject the caller.
Retry-count parsing accepts any text that `Number` converts to an integer from 0 through 3, including text that is not base-10 digits such as `'0x2'`.
A failure marked `transient: false` that carries a finite `retryAfter` is rewrapped as transient, so publication retries do not stop for it.
A suspended actor keeps the scopes of its active claims in `effectiveScopes`, so `canPlanRoute` can still allow it.
Delivery notices are sent to the raw `phone`, so an entry whose `phone` contains spaces or hyphens is not notified at its contact phone (rule 33).
A server-provided `retryAfter` of 0 is falsy, so `nextRetryDelay` uses the computed backoff instead of the server delay.
